field.label: Resolver strategy
field.help: How upstream resolvers within a group are queried: parallel_best races two random resolvers and takes the fastest, random picks one, strict tries them in order.

field.label: Upstream timeout
field.help: Time to wait for an upstream resolver before giving up, e.g. 2s or 500ms.

field.label: Bootstrap DNS
field.help: Plain-IP resolver(s) used to resolve the host names of upstream resolvers (for DoT/DoH upstreams). Type a value and press Enter to add it.

field.label: Startup strategy
field.help: Behaviour when connecting to upstreams at startup: blocking waits, failOnError aborts startup on failure, fast starts immediately.

field.label: HTTP User-Agent
field.help: Custom User-Agent header sent to DoH upstreams. Leave empty for the default.

field.label: QUIC max idle timeout
field.help: Only relevant when QUIC (quic:) upstreams are configured. Maximum idle time before closing a QUIC connection.

field.label: QUIC keep-alive period
field.help: Only relevant when QUIC (quic:) upstreams are configured. Keep-alive interval to maintain a QUIC connection.
